problem.description: User reports a Windows sp.exe dialog failing in pyi_rth_pkgres.py before application startup

hypotheses.description: The user launched an earlier executable built while setuptools was excluded
The current candidate ZIP lost jaraco.text during packaging or extraction
The user-selected extraction directory is incomplete

tests_run.command: Inspect sp.spec and prior executable smoke evidence
tests_run.output: Current spec does not exclude setuptools; prior extracted ZIP smoke report passes before and after the runtime hook

tests_run.command: Compare current dist/sp/sp.exe and extracted candidate executable SHA-256
Run current dist/sp/sp.exe with packaged smoke script
tests_run.output: PASS, CLI reports 4.14, stderr is empty; runtime hook loaded successfully

tests_run.command: Compare user-selected directory with verified extraction
tests_run.output: Same sp.exe SHA-256; user directory had 5,266 files and 0.34 GB versus 11,407 files and 6.38 GB; Lorem ipsum.txt was absent

tests_run.command: Copy verified files after stopping the failed sp.exe process, then smoke the user-selected directory
tests_run.output: Robocopy exit 1; 11,407 files and Lorem ipsum.txt present; packaged smoke PASS with empty stderr; GUI remained running for 15 seconds and created user data

findings: The reported sp.exe hash matched the verified candidate, so the executable itself was current
The user-selected extraction directory was incomplete and lacked most bundled data files
The mechanism that interrupted the user's extraction was not observed

resolution.root_cause: The user launched the current executable from a partially extracted onedir bundle; its bundled setuptools jaraco data file was missing
resolution.fix_applied: Completed the user-selected extraction directory from the SHA-256-verified, fully extracted candidate copy
resolution.verification: 11,407 files and 6.38 GB present; direct packaged smoke passed, CLI reported 4.14, stderr empty; normal GUI startup survived 15 seconds
